dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge forming a moderately falcate curvature from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a small pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear incline of approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height of the visible fin structure.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual, large-radius convexity forming a smooth, rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak profile with high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 155 degrees at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, pale circular depigmentation marks on the dorsal ridge and anterior melon; distinct dark circular pigment spot on the lateral flank below the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Anatomical blowhole aperture visible on the dorsal surface of the cranium; ocular orbit visible posterior to the rostrum gape.
